why_the_full_suite: This order REGISTERS a market. A registration is the one change class that re-tests every project-wide assumption about which markets exist, so no narrow lane is admissible and the broad run is mandatory.
proof_method: SET IDENTITY by node id, never counts. A matching failure COUNT is not a proof: it is equally consistent with one baseline failure being fixed and one new failure appearing. The assertion below is that the run's failing node-id set and the baseline's are the same set.

every_new_failure_was_this_orders_own.tests/pettripfinder/test_affiliate_desti: APPLIER DEFECT. Toledo's policy records were written without the record envelope the contract requires. Fixed at cause by validating every record through policy_schema.validate_record INSIDE the applier, which now refuses to write instead of leaving a broken shard for a test to find.
every_new_failure_was_this_orders_own.tests/pettripfinder/test_factory_through: REGISTRY COUNT. The suite enumerates registered markets; Toledo is the twelfth.
REGISTRY COUNT. The committed test inventory was regenerated to include this order's two suites.
every_new_failure_was_this_orders_own.tests/pettripfinder/test_global_assemble: APPLIER DEFECT. Flat pet fees were published as fee_tiers with invalid enum values (role PRICE, condition_type none). A tier requires a real condition; a flat fee has none and belongs in pet_fee. Fixed at cause in fee_from(), then the expected Toledo count was added to the assembler suite.
every_new_failure_was_this_orders_own.tests/pettripfinder/test_launch_particip: REGISTRY COUNT. Toledo joins Detroit as a registered market that does not participate.
every_new_failure_was_this_orders_own.tests/pettripfinder/test_markets.py::tes: REGISTRY COUNT. The expected market id list grew by toledo-oh.
every_new_failure_was_this_orders_own.tests/pettripfinder/test_service_animal_: APPLIER DEFECT. service_animal_statement was written inside facts, where policy_schema flags it as a MISPLACED_FIELD by name. Fixed at cause: the statement is a record-level structured field, not a fact.
every_new_failure_was_this_orders_own.tests/pettripfinder/test_st_louis_produc: REGISTRY COUNT. len(load_markets()) moved from 11 to 12.
every_new_failure_was_this_orders_own.tests/pettripfinder/test_two_market_comp: TEST USED toledo-oh AS ITS EXAMPLE of an unregistered id, so it silently stopped asserting anything the moment Toledo registered. Repointed at not-a-market-zz, an id no market can hold. The same latent defect was fixed in test_per_market_release_contracts and test_market_authority_sharding.

run_1.disposition: All 9 were fixed AT CAUSE. Three were real applier defects that would have shipped a package the record contract rejects; five were registry counts that a twelfth market legitimately moves; one was a project test that had used toledo-oh as its example of an unregistered id. No gate was weakened or scoped away.

verdict: CLEAN -- the broad run reproduces the f75aa95 baseline failure set EXACTLY by node id, 0 TRUE_NEW_FAILURE
